title: maturing is realizing having no competitors is a red flag 🥲
description:
maturing is realizing “there are no competitors!” is actually a bad thing 🥲

It took me a while to figure this out but more competition is actually a good thing especially when you're just getting started 

The two biggest reasons are that you have a lot of blueprints and failures/successes to study 

Not even from a marketing perspective but even from a UI perspective or a paywall perspective 

Second, marketing is usually ten times easier if there's a lot of competition because money has already been spent to educate users and you can just piggyback off of it 

If you are in a space with very few competitors, you are going to have to be the one to make that investment, educate users, and get them to resonate with their problem and your solution 

Super counterintuitive but now I prefer to enter markets with a lot of competition 😅
